cases.title: Nettle-water
cases.semanticExcerpt:
[[File:Nettle-water detail.png|left|120px]]
'''Nettle-water''' is an item created in the process of making [[nettle tea]]. This item is made by adding [[nettles]] to a [[bowl of water]]. This requires a [[Cooking]] level of 20. Historically, this item gave 1 cooking exp per creation, however this is no longer the case. The player is healed 1 Hitpoint when drank. However, it is not advised to consume this item because it has potential to heal more when made into tea. Nettle-water can be cooked on a range or fire to produce nettle tea. This item is usually only used during the [[Ghosts Ahoy]] quest and the [[Skippy and the Mogres]] [[miniquest]].

cases.title: Barley malt
cases.semanticExcerpt:
[[File:Barley malt detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Barley malt''' is an ingredient of [[brewing]] and a protection payment for [[jute seed]] [[hops patch]]es. It is made by cooking [[barley]] on a [[range]] only, yielding no experience.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Barley malt detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Barley malt''' is an ingredient of [[brewing]] and a protection payment for [[jute seed]] [[hops patch]]es. It is made by cooking [[barley]] on a [[range]] only, yielding no experience.
secondaryExcerpts: In brewing, it is used as an ingredient of every [[ale]]. Two barley malt are added to a [[fermenting vat]] after two [[buckets of water]], followed by [[the stuff]] and/or the main deciding ingredient of the ale, then [[ale yeast]].
In [[Farming]], six barley malt are paid to a [[Group of Advanced Gardeners]] farmer for protection of [[Jute seed|jute seeds]] in a hops patch.
Two are required for the [[Forgettable Tale...]] [[quest]] to brew [[Kelda stout]].
